detail.body:
# AutoEP + AutoTP folding: Universal Checkpointing under ZeRO-3

<!-- r3 2026-10-15. Branch peng-autoep-folding-ucp-v1 (worktree /fsx/peng/workspace/ds-autoep-folding-ucp) on master 5f266e26d, not committed. New branch; the change was prepared locally (pr-prep/r2/folding-ucp) and never pushed. -->

**Part of:** #8672 (Q4 2026 roadmap), "Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) Training Scaling and Kernel Development": "AutoEP Performance Optimization & Parallel Folding (AutoEP + AutoTP)" (PoC @tohtana @pengdurice). Follows #8670.

## Problem

#8670 makes `ds_to_universal` refuse a folded ZeRO-3 checkpoint: "Universal checkpoint conversion of an AutoEP +
AutoTP folded ZeRO-3 checkpoint is not supported yet. Load it with the same topology." So a folded run can only resume
with the same TP size, EP size and number of GPUs.

Three things stood in the way: two in the conversion, one in the load.

1. **File keys.** The AutoEP expert step of the ZeRO-3 conversion keyed checkpoint files by the ZeRO data-parallel rank
   alone (`_zero3_rank_from_file`). ZeRO-3 files are named `zero_pp_rank_{dp}_mp_rank_{tp}`. Under folding the files of
   different TP ranks share a data-parallel rank, so they collided. That is why #8670 refused.
2. **The TP merge's strict check.** `_merge_tp_slice_files` asserts that every pattern in AutoTP's universal info was
   used. AutoTP lists the AutoEP expert weights (`experts.w1/w2/w3`) among `tp_replicated_parameter_patterns`. Those
   weights are merged by the AutoEP step, not by the TP merge, so their patterns are never used and the assertion
   fails.
3. **The layout check on load.** `_load_checkpoint` compares the folding layout recorded in the model-states file with
   the runtime's (`_validate_autoep_folding_checkpoint_metadata`). This rejects any other TP size, EP size or an
   unfolded runtime, although a universal load re-cuts every tensor for the runtime's layout.

## Change

- `deepspeed/checkpoint/ds_to_universal.py`:
  - The AutoEP ZeRO-3 files are keyed by (TP rank, DP rank), with `_zero3_tp_dp_ranks_from_file`, which the dense
    merge already uses. `_zero3_rank_from_file` is no longer used and is removed, along with the folding refusal.
  - `_merge_tp_slice_files` no longer counts a pattern as unused when it only matches parameters excluded from this
    merge. The ZeRO-3 path now passes the AutoEP expert names as excluded; the ZeRO-1/2 path already did.
  - The expert reassembly itself is unchanged. It already uses each file's EP rank and ZeRO partition rank. Under
    folding each expert slice exists on exactly one rank, and the existing duplicate and completeness checks still
    apply.
- `deepspeed/runtime/engine.py` `_load_checkpoint`: skip the folding-layout check when `checkpoint.load_universal` is
  set. Rigid loads keep it.
- Loading tensors needs no change. For each parameter, `load_hp_checkpoint_state` in `stage3.py` cuts the EP slice,
  then the TP shard, then the ZeRO partition in the parameter's own group (dense data-parallel or expert
  data-parallel). That is what folding needs.
- Docs: `docs/code-docs/source/autoep.rst` and `docs/_pages/config-json.md`.
- Tests, in `tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_autotp_sharded_attention.py`:
  - `TestZero3FoldedCheckpoint` no longer expects the conversion to be refused.
  - New `TestZero3FoldedUniversalCheckpoint`. A distributed fixture trains a folded TP 2 x EP 2 run on 4 ranks for one
    AdamW step, saves, converts, and records every parameter and both Adam states at full size, then the losses and
    parameters of the next step. Each target layout loads the universal checkpoint and must restore every recorded
    tensor exactly. Targets with the source's 2 data-parallel groups read the same batches, so they must also repeat
    the next step. Targets: the same layout, EP 4, TP 4, 8 ranks with TP 4, and AutoEP without AutoTP; each in fp32
    and bf16.

ZeRO-1/2 conversion of folded checkpoints is not covered: it stores experts in per-expert files, one per TP rank,
and is still refused in `autoep_universal.py` (`resolve_expert_ckpt_path`).

## Tests

On master `d371f33cc` with this change, one node of 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, torch 2.8.0+cu126 (and master
without the change).

| File | Result |
|---|---|
| `tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_autotp_sharded_attention.py` (includes the 10 new universal-checkpoint cases) | 43 passed, 2 failed: `TestTiedOutputHead::test_row_parallel_tied_head_is_refused` (2 cases) fails the same on master `d371f33cc` without this change: the test expects AutoTP to refuse a row-parallel output head tied to the embedding, and master no longer does |
| `tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_checkpoint.py` | 43 passed |
| `tests/unit/checkpoint/test_autotp_uc_checkpoint.py` | 38 passed, 1 failed, 6 errors: the same tests fail on master without this change (see below) |
| `tests/unit/runtime/tensor_parallel/test_autotp_universal_checkpoint.py` | 33 passed |
| `tests/unit/checkpoint/test_autoep_affine_universal.py` | 20 passed |
| `tests/unit/checkpoint/test_universal_checkpoint.py` | 144 errors: the same on master without this change (see below) |

The failures in these two files do not come from this change. Master `d371f33cc` without this change gives the same
failing tests:

- 6 errors in `test_autotp_uc_checkpoint.py` and all 144 in `test_universal_checkpoint.py` are "fixture ... not found"
  for fixtures defined as `DistributedFixture` classes (`affine_resume_checkpoint`, `baseline_ws2`, `baseline_ws4`).
  This environment has pytest 9.1.1, which does not recognize the `_pytestfixturefunction` attribute that
  `tests/unit/common.py` sets to register those classes as fixtures.
- 1 failure in `test_autotp_uc_checkpoint.py` (`TestRealCheckpointUniversalConversionTPxPP::test`): gloo
  "Connection closed by peer" in the conversion's worker pool.


On master 5f266e26d (2026-10-15; 1 node of 8 H200, driver 580.126.09, torch 2.8.0+cu126), the failing
tests are the same with and without this change:

| File | With this change | Master 5f266e26d without it |
|---|---|---|
| `test_autoep_autotp_sharded_attention.py` | 43 passed, 2 failed (`TestTiedOutputHead`, 2 cases) | 33 passed, 2 failed (the same 2) |
| `test_autoep_checkpoint.py` | 43 passed | not rerun |
| `test_autotp_uc_checkpoint.py` | 38 passed, 1 failed, 6 errors | 38 passed, 1 failed, 6 errors (the same tests) |
| `test_autotp_universal_checkpoint.py` | 33 passed | not rerun |
| `test_autoep_affine_universal.py` | 20 passed | not rerun |

The 6 errors are "fixture ... not found" (`affine_resume_checkpoint` 4, `uneven_vocab_checkpoint` 2) and the failure is
gloo "Connection closed by peer" in `TestRealCheckpointUniversalConversionTPxPP::test`, on both sides.

## Further checks (not part of the PR's tests)

A wider version of the new test: 7 target layouts. Besides the 5 above: 8 ranks with TP 2 x EP 4, and AutoEP EP 4
without AutoTP. Run in fp32 and bf16, with the optimizer-offload PR for folding applied, and in 3 offload
combinations: saved and loaded without offload, saved and loaded with offload, saved without and loaded with offload.
All 42 loads restore every parameter and both Adam states exactly. Every target with the source's 2 data-parallel
groups repeats the next step: losses equal, and parameters within 1e-4 relative, leaving out the attention key bias.
In bf16 only the same layout repeats it.

The key bias is left out of the next-step comparison because its true gradient is zero. Its computed gradient is
rounding noise that another layout adds up in another order, and AdamW turns that noise into steps of about lr
(observed differences 6e-4 to 1.5e-3 relative).

## Duplicate check

Searched open and recent pull requests on 2026-10-15 ("universal checkpoint", "ds_to_universal", "folding", "AutoEP"): none converts folded ZeRO-3 checkpoints. #8800 plans live expert transfers between placements; #8637 links ZeRO-1/2 fragments.

## Proposal

New functionality: per CONTRIBUTING.md it needs an accepted proposal issue first. Draft:
`descriptions/r3/peng-autoep-folding-ucp-v1-proposal-issue.md`. TODO(user): open the issue, wait for acceptance, then link it here.

## AI assistance

This change, its tests and this description were prepared with AI assistance (Claude).

+def _universal_config(tp_size, ep_size, precision):
+    config = _folded_config(tp_size, ep_size, zero_stage=3)
+    # Universal Checkpointing converts Adam's states.
+    config["optimizer"] = {"type": "AdamW", "params": {"lr": 1e-3, "weight_decay": 0.01}}
+    if tp_size == 1:

+def _build_universal_engine(tp_size, ep_size, precision, seed, load_universal=False):
+    config = _universal_config(tp_size, ep_size, precision)
+    if load_universal:
+        config["checkpoint"] = {"load_universal": True}
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    model = transformers.Glm4MoeForCausalLM(_tiny_glm4_moe_config()).float()
+    engine, _, _, _ = deepspeed.initialize(model=model, config=config)
+    return engine
+
+
+def _logical_state(engine, key, tp_size):
+    """Every parameter, or one of its Adam states, at full size under names every layout shares."""
+
+    def full(param):
+        if key == "fp32":
+            return safe_get_full_fp32_param(param)
+        return safe_get_full_optimizer_state(param, key)
+
+    values = {}
+    moe_layers = []
+    for module_name, module in engine.module.named_modules():
+        prefix = f"{module_name}." if module_name else ""
+        if isinstance(module, AutoEPMoELayer):
+            moe_layers.append((prefix, module))
+        for name, param in module.named_parameters(recurse=False):
+            value = full(param)
+            assert value is not None, f"{prefix}{name} has no {key}"
+            if tp_size > 1 and isinstance(module, LinearAllreduce) and name == "weight":
+                value = _gather_tp_shards(value, dim=1)
+            elif tp_size > 1 and isinstance(module, LinearLayer):
+                value = _gather_tp_shards(value, dim=0)
+            values[f"{prefix}{name}"] = value
+    # Each EP rank holds a block of experts; the full tensor stacks them in EP-rank order.
+    for prefix, module in moe_layers:
+        for wname in ("w1", "w2", "w3"):
+            local = values[f"{prefix}experts.{wname}"]
+            shards = [torch.empty_like(local) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size(group=module.ep_group))]
+            dist.all_gather(shards, local.contiguous(), group=module.ep_group)
+            values[f"{prefix}experts.{wname}"] = torch.cat(shards, dim=0)
+    return {name: value.detach().float().cpu() for name, value in values.items()}
+
+
+def _universal_mismatches(got, want, rtol, atol):
+    assert got.keys() == want.keys(), sorted(set(got) ^ set(want))
+    mismatches = []
+    for name, expected in want.items():
+        actual = got[name]
+        if actual.shape != expected.shape:
+            mismatches.append(f"{name}: shape {tuple(actual.shape)}, expected {tuple(expected.shape)}")
+        elif not torch.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=rtol, atol=atol):
+            relative = (actual - expected).abs().max().item() / max(expected.abs().max().item(), 1e-12)
+            mismatches.append(f"{name}: largest relative difference {relative:.3e}")
+    return mismatches
+
+
+class _FoldedUniversalSource(DistributedFixture):
+    """Train a folded TP 2 x EP 2 run one step, save it, convert it, and record what a load must restore.
+
+    The record holds every parameter and Adam state at full size after the step, then the losses of
+    the next accumulation window and the parameters after the next step.
+    """
+    world_size = 4
+
+    def run(self, universal_precision, tmpdir):
+        tp_size, ep_size = UNIVERSAL_SOURCE
+        engine = _build_universal_engine(tp_size, ep_size, universal_precision, seed=1234)
+        logical_rank, logical_world_size = dist.get_rank() // tp_size, dist.get_world_size() // tp_size
+        _run_to_boundary(engine, logical_rank, logical_world_size)
+        engine.step()
+        save_dir = str(tmpdir)
+        engine.save_checkpoint(save_dir, tag="step1")
+
+        dist.barrier()
+        error = None
+        if dist.get_rank() == 0:
+            try:
+                ds_to_universal.main(
+                    SimpleNamespace(input_folder=os.path.join(save_dir, "step1"),
+                                    output_folder=os.path.join(save_dir, "step1_universal"),
+                                    num_extract_workers=1,
+                                    num_merge_workers=1,
+                                    keep_temp_folder=False,
+                                    strict=True,
+                                    inject_missing_state=False))
+            except Exception as exc:  # report on every rank instead of leaving them in the next collective
+                error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
+        errors = [None] * dist.get_world_size()
+        dist.all_gather_object(errors, error)
+        assert errors[0] is None, f"universal conversion failed: {errors[0]}"
+
+        states = {key: _logical_state(engine, key, tp_size) for key in UNIVERSAL_STATES}
+        losses = _run_to_boundary(engine, logical_rank, logical_world_size)
+        engine.step()
+        params_after = _logical_state(engine, "fp32", tp_size)
+        all_losses = [None] * dist.get_world_size()
+        dist.all_gather_object(all_losses, losses)
+        if dist.get_rank() == 0:
+            torch.save({
+                "states": states,
+                "next_losses": all_losses,
+                "next_params": params_after
+            }, os.path.join(save_dir, "source_record.pt"))
+        dist.barrier()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=["fp32", "bf16"])
+def universal_precision(request):
+    return request.param
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def folded_universal_source(request):
+    _FoldedUniversalSource()(request)
+
+
+UNIVERSAL_TARGETS = [
+    (4, 2, 2),  # the same layout
+    (4, 2, 4),  # EP 4: each EP group spans both TP groups
+    (4, 4, 2),  # TP 4: one data-parallel group
+    (8, 4, 2),  # more ranks with the same 2 data-parallel groups
+    (2, 1, 2),  # AutoEP without AutoTP, 2 data-parallel groups
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("world_size, tp_size, ep_size", UNIVERSAL_TARGETS)
+class TestZero3FoldedUniversalCheckpoint(DistributedTest):
+    """A folded ZeRO-3 checkpoint converted to the universal format loads into another layout.
+
+    Every parameter and Adam state must come back exactly. Layouts with the source's 2 data-parallel
+    groups read the same batches, so they must also repeat its next step.
+    """
+
+    def test_universal_load_restores_and_resumes(self, folded_universal_source, universal_precision, tmpdir,
+                                                 world_size, tp_size, ep_size):
+        if get_accelerator().device_name() == "cpu":
+            pytest.skip("AutoEP folding runs on an accelerator")
+        save_dir = str(tmpdir)
+        record = torch.load(os.path.join(save_dir, "source_record.pt"), weights_only=False)
+        engine = _build_universal_engine(tp_size, ep_size, universal_precision, seed=999, load_universal=True)
+        engine.load_checkpoint(save_dir, tag="step1_universal")
+
+        # Every rank finishes its collectives before any assertion, so a failure cannot leave others waiting.
+        problems = []
+        for key in UNIVERSAL_STATES:
+            loaded = _logical_state(engine, key, tp_size)
+            problems += [f"{key}: {m}" for m in _universal_mismatches(loaded, record["states"][key], 1e-6, 1e-8)]
+
+        source_tp, source_ep = UNIVERSAL_SOURCE
+        logical_world_size = world_size // tp_size
+        same_batches = logical_world_size == 4 // source_tp
+        same_layout = (world_size, tp_size, ep_size) == (4, source_tp, source_ep)
+        # In bf16 another TP split rounds the forward differently, so there only the same layout repeats the step.
+        if same_batches and (universal_precision == "fp32" or same_layout):
+            logical_rank = dist.get_rank() // tp_size
+            losses = _run_to_boundary(engine, logical_rank, logical_world_size)
+            engine.step()
+            want_losses = record["next_losses"][logical_rank * source_tp]
+            if max(abs(got - want) for got, want in zip(losses, want_losses)) > 1e-5:
+                problems.append(f"next losses {losses}, expected {want_losses}")
+            # The attention key bias has a zero true gradient, so its gradient is rounding noise that
+            # another layout adds up in another order, and AdamW turns that noise into steps of about lr.
+            after = {
+                name: value
+                for name, value in _logical_state(engine, "fp32", tp_size).items() if not name.endswith("k_proj.bias")
+            }
+            want = {name: record["next_params"][name] for name in after}
+            problems += [f"after the next step: {m}" for m in _universal_mismatches(after, want, 1e-4, 1e-6)]
+
+        assert not problems, f"{len(problems)} problems:\n" + "\n".join(problems[:40])
 
 
 class _LlamaWithoutTPPlan(transformers.LlamaForCausalLM):

reviews.body:
Thanks for picking this up, it fills an important gap for the folding work. I went through the converter path for folded ZeRO-3: routed experts aren't TP-sliced under folding (expert TP = 1), fragments don't collide since each global rank has a unique `(ep_rank, edp_rank)`, ZeRO padding is stripped via `ds_zero_partition_groups`, and TP-replicated params go through `replicated_map.rebuild`. A synthetic folded grid over 7 layouts with odd sizes (so EDP padding occurs) reassembles fp32 / `exp_avg` / `exp_avg_sq` bitwise for me. The engine change is a no-op for non-folded runs, and comparing against the source engine's live state in the GPU test is the right reference.

**1. [blocking] Existing unit test now fails with `KeyError: 0`** — [`ds_to_universal.py:709`](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/9362efc52a983830845a2048e1ff562fbbdf4cd5/deepspeed/checkpoint/ds_to_universal.py#L709), [`test_autoep_unit.py:941`](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/9362efc52a983830845a2048e1ff562fbbdf4cd5/tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_unit.py#L941)

`_autoep_expert_param_names_by_rank` now keys `metadata_by_rank` by `(tp_rank, dp_rank)`, but `test_universal_converter_detects_zero3_partitioned_autoep_model_state` still indexes `metadata_by_rank[0]`. It fails on CPU (`DS_ACCELERATOR=cpu`), and it's the one failure in the `cpu-torch-latest` check on 9362efc. Could you update it to `metadata_by_rank[(0, 0)]` and note the key shape in the helper's docstring, since other tests import it?

**2. [should-fix] Docs promise module-only loads that aren't tested** — [`config-json.md:1147`](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/9362efc52a983830845a2048e1ff562fbbdf4cd5/docs/_pages/config-json.md#L1147)

The new text promises weights-only / module-only universal loads at a different `autotp_size`, but `TestZero3FoldedUniversalCheckpoint` only exercises the default `load_checkpoint`. Module-only goes through `load_module_checkpoint_state_from_checkpoint_dir_stage3`, which never sees a folded source here. Could you add one `load_module_only=True` target that compares fp32 against the recorded state, or narrow the docs? Also, autoep.rst around L597 still says only `autoep_size` / DP size can change via universal checkpointing; worth mentioning `autotp_size` for folded runs.

**3. [should-fix] CI covers a narrow set of layout changes** — [`test_autoep_autotp_sharded_attention.py:529-535`](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/9362efc52a983830845a2048e1ff562fbbdf4cd5/tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_autotp_sharded_attention.py#L529-L535)

On the 4-GPU runners `(8, 4, 2)` skips, so no CI-run target grows the dense DP degree; only `(4, 4, 2)` changes it, down to 1. A 4-rank `(4, 1, 4)` target would move dense DP 2→4, EDP 2→1 and TP 2→1 in one case. Also, with `ATTENTION_ONLY_TP_SPECS` only q/k/v (+bias) and o_proj are TP-sliced; the default-spec layouts (MLP gate/up column, down row, row-parallel bias, vocab-parallel embedding/head) never reach this converter path. One `use_default_specs` target, or a note in the description that they're out of scope?

**4. [question] Experts are published as TP-replicated in the AutoTP UC metadata** — [`ds_to_universal.py:608-611`](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/9362efc52a983830845a2048e1ff562fbbdf4cd5/deepspeed/checkpoint/ds_to_universal.py#L608-L611)

Under folding, `collect_autotp_universal_checkpoint_info` publishes `...experts.w[123]` as TP-replicated with a `replicated_map` over the EP-local shape, but TP peers hold different experts (with TP=EP=2 the groups coincide). Filtering those patterns out of the strict check works for this converter, but the metadata itself stays wrong. Would it be cleaner to skip AutoEP expert params when collecting AutoTP UC info? Anything that later plans from `AFFINE_MAP` in UC info (e.g. the shard-to-shard planner / executor) would otherwise trust a wrong map.

**5. [nit] `k_proj.bias` exclusion** — [`test_autoep_autotp_sharded_attention.py:577`](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/9362efc52a983830845a2048e1ff562fbbdf4cd5/tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_autotp_sharded_attention.py#L577)

The key bias only has a zero true gradient on its non-rotary half. With `partial_rotary_factor=0.5` the rotary half is rotated by position-dependent RoPE; in fp64 on this tiny GLM-4-MoE I get max |grad| ≈ 1e-4 on the rotary dims (same order as `q_proj.bias`) vs ≈ 4e-11 on the pass-through dims. Could you exclude only `[..., int(head_dim * partial_rotary_factor):]` of each head instead of dropping the whole tensor?

**6. [nit] Fallback partition values** — [`ds_to_universal.py:870-871`](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/9362efc52a983830845a2048e1ff562fbbdf4cd5/deepspeed/checkpoint/ds_to_universal.py#L870-L871)

If `ds_zero_partition_groups` were missing, this falls back to the dense DP size / rank, which is wrong for expert sub-groups (partitioned over EDP). Every partition-native AutoEP ZeRO-3 checkpoint writes it, so raising here seems safer than guessing.
